set -eu
root=$(mktemp -d)
upload='/workspace/repository/.delegatus-check-capture-1'
trap 'python3 -c '\''import shutil,sys; [shutil.rmtree(p) for p in sys.argv[1:]]'\'' "$root" "$upload"' EXIT
base64 -d '/workspace/repository/.delegatus-check-capture-1/bundle' > "$root/source.bundle"
git clone -q --no-hardlinks '/workspace/repository' "$root/repo"
if ! git -C "$root/repo" cat-file -e 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}' 2>/dev/null; then
  git -C "$root/repo" fetch -q --no-tags "$(git -C '/workspace/repository' remote get-url origin)" 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc'
fi
git -C "$root/repo" fetch -q "$root/source.bundle" HEAD
cd "$root/repo"
git checkout -q --detach 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'
git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc'
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb'

mkdir -p "$root/home" "$root/config" "$root/tmp" "$root/state"
env -i PATH="$PATH" LANG='en_US.UTF-8' LOGNAME='fixture' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=11264' SHELL='/bin/bash' USER='fixture' HOME="$root/home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$root/config" TMPDIR="$root/tmp" LLV_STATE_DIR="$root/state" bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
set +e
env -i PATH="$PATH" LANG='en_US.UTF-8' LOGNAME='fixture' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=11264' SHELL='/bin/bash' USER='fixture' HOME="$root/home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$root/config" TMPDIR="$root/tmp" LLV_STATE_DIR="$root/state" LLV_SKIP_HOOKS=0 LLV_GATE_PUSH_HEAD='aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' LLV_GATE_RUNNER=off LLV_GATE_EXECUTION=local DELEGATUS_AGENT_CPU=off bun scripts/local-gate.ts pre-push --admitted
code=$?
set -e
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb'
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
printf '\nDELEGATUS_GATE aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc cf8c1e879d91d91d58097f82c5aa613d32632b5bedc5b89c0c1873d06a80bd11 %s\n' "$code"
